# Releases

out/ is not in git. out/build holds build output. out/archive holds every past release and cannot be rebuilt.

--- release.sh ---
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
unexpected=$(find out -type f -not -path "out/build/*" | wc -l)
if [ "$unexpected" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "release.sh: out/ holds $unexpected files that are not build output; clean it first" >&2; exit 3
fi
tar -cf release.tar out/build
echo released

--- clean.sh ---
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Clear out/ so that release.sh sees only build output.
set -e
